items.title: Lee Paige Interview, 1961-01-13
items.q: I remember walking down Bourbon Street with three of the newspaper reporters, the States and Adam and the other newspaper they had here at that time.

ctx.x: Didn't the three newspapers at one time in New Orleans, Lee, verify that everyone on Bourbon Street knew you?

Oh, yes. I remember walking down Bourbon Street with three of the newspaper reporters, the States and Adam and the other newspaper they had here at that time. And everybody, when I was going down the street with them, everybody was hollering at me. The shoeshine boys, the garbage men, the nightclub owners and the show girls and show people were all hollering at me.
